verdict.rationale: Firebase ships an official, documented CLI (firebase-tools) for deploying code and assets, running a local Hosting server, working with database data, and importing or exporting Auth users. It also provides `login:ci` tokens for non-interactive environments, which suits automated and agent-driven workflows, and a community user confirms relying on the CLI in production. Missing for 10: no evidence of machine-readable/JSON output or explicit agent-oriented CLI documentation, and only thin independent hands-on corroboration of agentic CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
